items.caption: A modern seal-style redraw of 彡, the graphic-semantic element in the conventional account of 影. Historical accounts describe 影 as 景 with 彡 added to distinguish the shadow writing; this image shows 彡 alone.
items.alt: Three black, curved strokes sweep diagonally upward across a white square, forming 彡.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the component named in the reported 景-plus-彡 account, while remaining distinct from a dated example of the complete character 影.

items.caption: A modern seal-style redraw of 景, the graph that historical accounts describe as used for shadow before 彡 was added in 影.
items.alt: A black seal-style graph for 景, with 日 above 京, centered on a white square.
items.selection_reason: Paired with the 彡 redraw, it helps illustrate the reported graphic differentiation. Neither modern redraw documents an early compound form of 影.

limitations.text: Both images are modern digital redrawings in Shuowen seal-script style. They show 景 and 彡 separately, not a dated ancient occurrence or the precise appearance of an early form of 影.
